text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way home from going out with Wonder 
Acute, she suddenly said this, as if just 
remembering something.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh, right, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
There's a place I'd like to drop by today, 
if that's all right with you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I followed Wonder Acute and walked for a 
while. But—before long, she came to a 
sudden stop.
choice_data_list:
Um... What was that place you wanted to 
stop by?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: ...Now where was that, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"I thought it was around here. Then again, 
I don't remember all the details."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Look, we were talking about cherry pie the 
other day, remember?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I've been curious ever since. I've been 
looking for that shop~.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Still, hmmm... as expected, I can't 
pinpoint the exact location, huh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I see. It looks like she's looking for 
that cake shop. I wonder if there's 
anything I can do to help...

What's wrong? You've been pacing in 
circles this whole time.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, Jordan-chan. Yes, I just can't 
get it to stop spinning.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I told Tosen Jordan that I couldn't seem 
to find the shop we were looking for.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Then can't we just use a smartphone? Uh, 
it was a cake shop, right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Looking at the map app... ah~. There's 
actually quite a few cake shops around 
here.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
What did the shop look like? Colors, the 
sign... Do you remember anything?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Ah, that's right. I think it 
had a red roof, kind of like that shop 
over there.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"'K. Guess I'll do an image search then. 
That roof, and—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Snap!)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Wah, that came out nicely. So... what are 
you going to do with that photo?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
You upload it, right? And then a bunch of 
similar stuff pops up.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
See? Told ya a bunch of red-roofed shops 
would pop up!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Wah!! W-W-Wah!? You can do that!?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Smartphones are so amazing~~! So teeny, 
yet so smart~~!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
You get it?! Exactly! It has a ton of 
other features too, you know~, like how 
you can crop out just the roof part like 
this—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
And then, when you do this to Acute-san's 
photo... it changes completely! Isn't that 
insane!?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Wahyaa~~!! Now this is amazing!! My ears 
turned into reindeer antlers!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The smartphone discussion continued for a 
while after that. Both Tosen Jordan 
teaching and Wonder Acute learning looked 
like they were having fun.
choice_data_list:
Why not take this chance to switch to a 
smartphone?
Looks like you had a good time.
Looks like you had a good time.

text_block_list.text:

while after that. Both Tosen Jordan 
teaching and Wonder Acute learning looked 
like they were having fun.
choice_data_list:
Why not take this chance to switch to a 
smartphone?
Looks like you had a good time.
Looks like you had a good time.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Who, me?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm fine, really. I can make calls 
and send texts with my current phone, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Flip phones are small and reliable too, 
you know. So don't you worry, okay?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Acute-san's texts have this nice, charming 
vibe to 'em~~ I kinda hope she never 
changes that, y'know~!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Smartphones really are amazing, 
aren't they~?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, all of you using your 
smartphones know so much, it's really 
impressive."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It sounds a bit tough for me, but I'd love 
to hear more about it if there's another 
chance.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me-shi! I'll master this 
god-tier feature in no time!
